title: "Mass difference"

---

Compare the masses of two formulas, running entirely in your browser via WebAssembly ([MassSpecToolkit](https://github.com/H3Jones/MassSpecToolkit)).

```{=html}
<script type="module" src="ms-toolkit/mass-split.mjs"></script>
<ms-mass-split formula-a="C14H23S" formula-b="C17H19"></ms-mass-split>
```
